zh: 需求图片上传自动压缩：选图上限放宽至 20MB，客户端自动等比缩放并转换为高质量 WebP 格式（体积降低 70%~90%），动图保真保留，大幅优化传输带宽与存储性能。
已关闭需求图片自动清理：需求评价归档或拒绝超过 30 天后，系统每日定时自动清理图片释放数据库空间，并在流转日志中留存系统审计记录。
需求图片接口缓存加速：图片获取接口支持 24 小时浏览器缓存，避免预览和流转时重复下载。
团队账号安全加固：数据探索、平台推广配置、工具说明生成等平台级操作仅超级管理员可用；平台共享的 MCP 服务对团队默认关闭，超级管理员可在「智能体工具」里开启。
团队账号可以使用对话里的浏览器：每个账号独立的浏览器进程运行在团队沙箱中，不能访问服务器本机和内网地址。
团队命令沙箱更可靠：改用真实沙箱规则检测可用性，装好依赖后一分钟内自动恢复，无需重启平台。
新增 Linux 服务器一键安装与自动更新脚本：定时拉取最新版本，启动异常自动回退到上一版。
媒体资源新增总开关，关闭后登录页与公开点播入口不再展示；意见反馈窗口在所有页面都可上传图片。
en: Requirement image auto-compression: raw file size limit relaxed to 20MB with client-side proportional downscaling and WebP compression (70%~90% size reduction), preserving animated GIFs intact.
Closed requirement image auto-cleanup: images for evaluated or rejected requirements older than 30 days are automatically reclaimed daily to free database storage, logging audit trails.
Requirement image cache optimization: image endpoints now serve 24-hour browser caching headers, preventing redundant downloads during review.
Team account hardening: the data explorer, promotion settings and tool-guide generation are now super admin only; shared MCP servers are off for teams by default and can be enabled under Agent Tools.
Team accounts can use the in-chat browser: each account gets its own browser process inside the team sandbox, with no access to the server itself or private networks.
More reliable team command sandbox: availability is checked with the real sandbox rules and recovers within a minute after dependencies are installed, with no restart.
New install and auto-update script for Linux servers: pulls the latest version on a timer and rolls back if the new version fails to start.
Media resources gain a master switch that hides the login-page and public playback entries when off; the feedback dialog can attach images on every page.
